channel.desc: A new episode of the internet sensation Punkest Prank inspires Ricky and Gav to prank each other in order to win a year's supply of Shampoo-Poo. Ricky enlists the ninja apprentices to help him make prank fake food and the Grand Master gets in on the act by creating a finger in a box to shock your friends.
